operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
it is hereby ordered that the last para­
graph of Executive Order No. 10906 of  
January 17,1961, entitled “Inspection by  
Certain Classes of Persons and State and  
Federal Government Establishments of  
Returns Made in Respect of Certain  
Taxes Imposed by the Internal Revenue  
Code of 1954,” be, and it is hereby,  
amended to read as follows:
“This order shall become effective  
upon its filing for publication in the  
F ederal R egister, and shall on that date  
supersede Executive Order No. 10738 of  
November 15, 1957, to the extent that  
such order is applicable to inspection by  
State tax officials after the effective date  
of this order of estate and gift-tax re­
turns made under the Internal Revenue  
Code of 1954.”
This order shall be effective as of Jan­
uary 18,1961.
